name: GR-75 B
description: GR-75 B was the designation of a GR-75 medium transport of the New Republic Defense Fleet that was active during the Galactic Civil War. During the war, GR-75 B was part of an automated New Republic convoy crewed by droids that was used in an operation to lure the Imperial ISD Overseer into the Zavian Abyss and destroy it.
